text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock E after gains, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each holding by its future prospects and portfolio role.","Selling at a loss feels painful, but avoiding that pain can keep me holding a poor investment; I should apply the same reasoned standard to winners and losers.","These few months of account changes do not reveal a reliable price pattern, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and trade only when my plan or circumstances warrant it."]}
